defects: Image-authored oak grain remains too narrow and repetitive at close and three-quarter distances.
The current reconstructed room shows blue-gray exterior through clear glazing rather than the green garden in the concept target; this is presentation context and must remain outside the door mesh.
hard_fail_reasons: Image-authored oak still resolves as repetitive narrow streaks rather than the approved target’s varied board-aligned figure.
incumbent_comparison: Against v005, v010 retains the four-row target layout, exposes all six hinge plates, and restores the exact 66 x 82 x 4-inch envelope. The oak remains narrow-grained and repetitive at the registered detail view, so the source-photo surface transfer is still below target. Keep v005 as best current review pending a materially different oak method.
next_action_hypothesis: For attempt 3, preserve v010’s exact geometry and visible hinge placement, but switch timber material_method to a Blender-authored anisotropic procedural PBR with broader figure and per-member phase variation. Compare the same registered captures, and do not add foliage to the mesh to compensate for the room context.

observations.art_direction_fit: Paired leaves, four rows of glazing, handles, oak frame, and exposed brass hinges follow the target; the grain remains too linear and repetitive.
observations.close_up_quality: The detail render shows all six hinge locations and recognizable grain, though hinge screws are tiny and texture streaks remain dense.
observations.gameplay_readability: The room overview reads as a distinct closed French-door pair in the existing opening. Hinge and surface detail are appropriately secondary at this distance.
observations.geometric_detail: Separate stiles, rails, eight clear lights per leaf, casing, threshold, hinge plates, barrels, and screw heads are present.
observations.material_realism: The r03 albedo supplies stained-oak color, but the mapped grain appears narrow and repeats across boards. The blue-gray room exterior does not match the concept garden, and that context is outside the door mesh.
observations.proportion: The leaves, rails, four-row glazing, jamb, and surround retain the approved target proportions.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot reports exact 66 x 82 x 4 inch bounds within the brief’s 0.01-inch per-axis tolerance.
observations.semantic_recognizability: Both production close views and room overview read as a residential French double door.
observations.silhouette_quality: Closed paired leaves, meeting stile, four rows of divided lights, casing, and threshold match the target.
observations.source_resemblance: The target layout and hardware are more faithfully transferred than v005; target wood figure is still broader and less repetitive.
observations.surface_variation: Lower UV density makes the streaks slightly broader than v009, but repeated straight grain still dominates several stiles.
observations.technical_integration: Godot imports six surfaces without issues and verifies exact 66 x 82 x 4 inch bounds; the production renderer loads the asset through the review registry.

close_inspection.evidence: The detail view shows six brass hinge locations and timber grain, but the grain pattern repeats and screws remain too fine to match the target.

edge_treatment.evidence: The three-quarter view shows beveled leaves, stepped casing, bead, and threshold.

craftsmanship.evidence: The geometry, joinery, hardware placement, depth, and edge treatment are improved; the material response remains below the source-conditioned target.

hardware.evidence: Three brass hinge assemblies per leaf are visible in both candidate detail and three-quarter views.

joins.evidence: The detail view resolves muntins meeting the stiles and rails around separate rectangular lights.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: Hinge plates and barrels are readable in the registered views, with screw-head details present at close range.

material_response.evidence: The r03 texture transfers stained-oak color but remains repetitive; the room exterior does not contain the target garden context.

surface_variation.evidence: Repeated narrow grain streaks remain visible across the timber in the detail and three-quarter views.

thickness.evidence: The three-quarter view shows the leaf, casing, and jamb depth inside the exact envelope.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The fitted door is recognizable and dimensionally correct, but the wood figure still repeats as narrow streaks instead of the approved target’s broader natural variation.

photo_character.evidence: Layout and hardware transfer; the target’s varied oak surface is not yet reproduced, and the room’s exterior context cannot show its garden.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: Preserve v010 geometry and exact bounds. Switch only the oak material method to broader anisotropic procedural PBR with deterministic per-board phase variation, then compare the same Godot captures. Keep exterior foliage outside the mesh.
lost_visual_information: The target has broader varied board-aligned oak figure; the candidate still repeats narrow linear streaks.
The target shows garden color through clear glass, while the supplied production room has blue-gray exterior context.
preserved_components: Paired silhouette with four rows of divided lights per leaf.
Six exposed hinge locations with separate plates and barrels.
Unchanged RoomDefinition, placement, collision, navigation, selection, and simulation.
